create_CnnParameters: create a CnnParameters namedtuple to configure convolutional layer dimensions, kernel sizes, and pooling types
build_ConvolutionalNetwork: build a ConvolutionalNetwork module with configurable conv layers, max pooling, and an attached fully connected network
run_conv_forward: run the conv_forward method to pass an image tensor through convolutional, layer norm, relu, and pooling layers
run_forward: run the forward method to pass an image tensor through the full convnet and feed-forward network pipeline
review_ConvolutionalNetwork_init: review the ConvolutionalNetwork constructor to understand how conv layers, pool layers, and feed-forward networks are initialized
